_provenance.derivation: Wire keys extracted mechanically from the Rust struct, as in download_response.json. Not transcribed from this SDK's dataclass.
_provenance.shape: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/releases/{release_id}/artifacts. A bare JsonApiDocument with `data` only — this route emits no `meta` and no `links`, which is why the SDK derives the keyset cursor from the page size it sent rather than reading one off the response.
_provenance.no_redirect_url: redirectUrl is ABSENT — not null — on every item. ArtifactAttributes.redirect_url carries skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none" (serializer.rs:30-31), and only the download action ever populates the underlying field. A parser that treats absence as malformed breaks the list route.
_provenance.second_item: status WAITING with null filesize/checksum is the real pre-upload state: confirm_upload (artifacts/queries.rs:188-210) is the only writer of those three columns, so they move together.
